summary.value: This paper presents blueprint-bench, a benchmark to evaluated the spatial intelligence of AI models. This is done through the task of converting apartment photographs into an accurate 2D floorpan. The authors evaluate various models, including both VLMs, image generation models, and agent systems. They find that models are consistently bellow human performance on this task.

reviewer_concerns.value: Reviewers were concerned about the efficacy of the benchmark, the validity of the claims, and the presentation of the work. I believe all of these concerns are still outstanding.

reviewer_scores.value: Given that the authors provided not rebuttal, I do not anticipate that the scores of any reviewer would have changed.
